every reader and verifier family of docs/conformance
browser_verifier.reports_version_as: OPENTINE_VERSION (browser build) / opentine-verify --version (Node) / opentine_version in a bundle report

description: Which OpenTine release the client packages in ts/ were built for, and the oldest browser verifier this release still supports. A client below minimum_supported cannot read everything current (for example bundles, or the 0.46-0.50 record families) and must say so instead of reporting a pass. Not an object kind: a manifest for embedders such as hosted viewers.
